test_configure_pytest_options: configure pytest CLI options by adding shared options from transformers.testing_utils.pytest_addoption_shared
run_pytest_terminal_reports: generate test summary reports at the end of a pytest run using the --make-reports option
setup_transformers_test_path: insert the transformers src directory into sys.path for test discovery across repository checkouts
suppress_future_warnings_in_tests: silence FutureWarning warnings during pytest execution to avoid noise from deprecated APIs
discover_pytest_fixtures_for_tests: discover and load pytest fixtures and hooks from the transformers testing utilities before test collection
